sections.heading: CERTIFICATE IN SPANISH (formerly the CERTIFICATE IN PRACTICAL SPANISH)
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Languages, Cultures, and Linguistics
Completion of first-year requirements including Spanish 1030 with a mark of at least 60% or Grade 12U Spanish. A student may not pursue both a Certificate in Spanish and a Spanish module.
1.0 course from: Spanish 2100 level or above.
Note: At least 2.0 of the 3.0 courses must be taken at Western.

To progress and complete the program, students must achieve and maintain a minimum average of 70% in the required courses. If a course in the Certificate program is waived by the department because of existing language proficiency, other Spanish courses will have to be taken so that the total number of course credits is 3.0.
